author: macroforge contributors
description: TypeScript macro expansion engine powered by Rust, Oxc, and WebAssembly
name: @macroforge/core

scripts.build: deno task build:wasm && deno task build:npm
scripts.build:wasm: deno install --node-modules-dir && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && deno run -A ../../tooling/scripts/bench.mjs --wasm-bindgen ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/macroforge_ts.wasm pkg
scripts.cleanbuild: deno task clean && deno task build
